newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - American Medical raised.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - American Medical raised.

text.p: -- Lehman Brothers said analyst Jeff Kessler upgraded American Medical Response Inc to buy from outperform.
-- At $30 the stock is an "excellent buy for the long term," the analyst said in a report.
-- He maintained his one-year price target on the stock of $38 to $40.

-- "While uncertainties over the acquisition of STAT Healthcare may cause the company to trade flat in the near term, we believe that the company will achieve our price target in a year," the report said.
-- The stock was up 1/8 at 30-1/8 in early trading.
